changes.description: Added 4 new pytest tests in the fleet-pin-divergence section covering: (1) agent with no trail at all gets flagged with lag_seconds=None and agent_latest_update=null, (2) held agents (dispatch_hold) are skipped even with ancient trail, (3) max across all 6 status streams wins so a recent skipped event prevents flagging, (4) exactly one deduped task per diverged agent on first run_once() and no additional task on second run_once()

assumptions: The test for test_pin_divergence_uses_max_across_all_statuses uses the skipped event at 23h ago with default pin_divergence_seconds=3h, so fleet_newest comes from the skipped event (23h) which is 23h stale. Since 23h > 3h the fleet_newest IS outside the divergence window. But the agent's latest across all streams is also 23h (the skipped event) which gives lag=0s, below the 3h threshold, so it is NOT flagged. This correctly validates the multi-stream merge.
